enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to chin. Adjust pillow. Remain asleep. Turn to right side. Stretch left arm. Remain asleep. Turn onto back. Breathe slowly.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Splash water on face. Wipe face with towel. Brush teeth (apply toothpaste, brush, rinse). Put on shirt and pants. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast (toast and tea) while skimming art history notes on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out bread and put in toaster. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Pick up phone. Open art history notes. Scroll through notes. Make tea (pour water, add tea bag). Take toast and spread butter. Eat toast and drink tea while scrolling. Rinse plate and mug.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by train and tram to Monash Caulfield campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to train station. Tap on with Myki. Wait on platform. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Check phone. Train arrives at station. Stand up. Exit train. Walk to tram stop. Wait for tram. Board tram. Tap on. Hold handrail. Tram arrives at campus. Exit tram. Walk to campus. Enter campus. Walk to library.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting in the campus library reviewing assigned art history readings before class
enriched_activities.desc: Enter library. Walk to empty desk. Pull out chair. Sit down. Open backpack. Take out laptop. Place laptop on desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for login. Type password. Open PDF of reading. Scroll down. Read. Highlight sentence. Type note. Scroll. Read. Check phone. Put phone down. Continue reading.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending Art History lecture at Monash Caulfield
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to lecture hall. Enter. Find seat. Sit down. Take out laptop. Open note-taking app. Type lecture title. Listen and type notes. Highlight important point. Check phone. Put phone away. Raise hand. Ask question. Listen to answer. Type answer. Stretch arms. Continue typing. Lecture ends. Close laptop. Put in bag. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending Creative Writing tutorial and workshopping a short prose piece
enriched_activities.desc: Enter tutorial room. Sit down. Take out printed story. Read aloud: "The sun set behind the hills." Listen to feedback: "I liked the imagery." Take notes. Ask question: "Could you clarify the ending?" Listen to answer. Write down suggestions. Discuss with peer: "I agree, the character needs more depth." Nod. Read another paragraph. Listen. Write more notes. Tutorial ends. Pack up. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating a packed lunch on campus and chatting briefly with classmates
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Find table. Sit down. Open bag. Take out lunch box. Open lunch box. Take out sandwich. Unwrap. Take bite. Talk to classmate: "How's your day?" Listen. Take another bite. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Continue talking: "Did you finish the reading?" Listen. Finish sandwich. Close lunch box. Put in bag. Stand up. Throw trash. Walk away.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking and taking the tram to the café where the shift starts
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to tram stop. Wait for tram. Board tram. Tap on. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Tram arrives at stop. Stand up. Exit tram. Walk to café. Enter café. Greet manager. Put on apron.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a part-time shift at the café, taking orders, making coffee and clearing tables
enriched_activities.desc: Greet customer. Take order. Write on notepad. Enter order into POS. Grind coffee beans. Tamp grounds. Brew espresso. Steam milk. Pour milk into cup. Serve coffee. Clear table. Wipe table. Carry dishes to sink. Rinse dishes. Restock cups. Take next order.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the café by tram and train
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to tram stop. Board tram. Tap on. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Tram arrives at station. Exit tram. Walk to train station. Board train. Sit down. Check phone. Train arrives at home station. Exit train. Walk home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Unwinding after the café shift and having a light snack while resting
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Take off shoes. Put bag down. Lie on bed. Pick up phone. Scroll social media. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out yogurt. Take spoon. Eat yogurt. Walk back to bedroom. Lie down. Continue phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a warm shower and washing up after the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Lather. Rinse. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on clean clothes. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a simple pasta dinner together with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member 1: "Hey, how was your day?" Open fridge. Take out pasta sauce and pasta. Fill pot with water. Turn on stove. Add pasta. Stir. Open jar of sauce. Pour into pan. Heat. Drain pasta. Mix with sauce. Serve on plates. Sit at table with Member 1. Eat. Talk: "This is good." Listen. Finish. Clear plates. Rinse. Put in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Writing a creative writing assignment on the computer with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Open Word document. Type. Pause. Scroll. Delete. Retype. Check phone. Put phone down. Continue typing. Get up. Stretch. Sit down. Type more. Save document.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading a novel on phone and winding down for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Pick up phone. Open reading app. Scroll to page. Read. Swipe page. Read. Adjust pillow. Read. Turn off phone. Put phone on nightstand. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain asleep. Turn to right side. Stretch arm. Remain asleep. Turn onto back. Breathe slowly.
